notes.title: Cologne 3D released on Steam – for free!
notes.notes:
Sunlight Games, a Cologne-based computer and video game developer, released today “Cologne 3D” for free on Steam. “Cologne 3D” is a 3D application that allows its users to take a glimpse into the past and present of classical cityscapes in Cologne.

“Cologne 3D” is a PC application that supports both conventional 3D graphics and VR. In it, users are able to check out the cityscapes of Alter Markt and the office building of the RTZ (Rechtsrheinisches Technologie- und Gründerzentrum) in the Kalk district. But that's not all: users will also be able to read detailed information about the cityscapes and can enjoy historic views of them, too.

notes.title: Köln 3D is coming to Steam – for free!
notes.notes:
Köln 3D is coming to Steam – for free!

Sunlight Games, a Cologne-based computer and video game developer, announced today that “Cologne 3D” will be available for free on Steam on October 01, 2021. “Cologne 3D” is a 3D application that allows its users to take a glimpse into the past and present of classical cityscapes in Cologne. The Steam page for “Cologne 3D” was going live today.

“Cologne 3D” is a PC application that supports both conventional 3D graphics and VR. In it, users are able to check out the cityscapes of Alter Markt and the office building of the RTZ (Rechtsrheinisches Technologie- und Gründerzentrum) in the Kalk district. But that's not all: users will also be able to read detailed information about the cityscapes and can enjoy historic views of them, too.
